texts.ch_assist_first: LynkAssist ce ke amsawa da farko. Mutum yana nan da taɓawa ɗaya.
texts.ch_assist_found: Na gode. Na samo odar kuma ina aika bayananta ga ƙungiyar. Za ka samu amsa a nan.
texts.ch_assist_order: Zan iya taimakawa da haka. Wane oda ne?
texts.ch_assist_payment: Biya yana nuna an biya ne kawai idan mai ba da sabis na biya ya tabbatar. Buɗe Sayarwa, sannan Yau, don ganin kowane biya da matsayinsa.
texts.ch_code_words: PIN, kalmar sirri, lambar sirri, OTP
texts.ch_conn_back_online: An dawo kan layi. Saƙonnin da aka aika: {n}.
texts.ch_conn_waiting_internet: Ana jiran intanet. Saƙonnin da ke jira: {n}. Za su tafi da kansu.
texts.ch_protected_note: Ana kare saƙonni yayin aikawa da lokacin ajiya.
texts.ch_reason_assistant_first: LynkAssist ce ke amsawa da farko; mutum yana shigowa idan ka nema.
texts.ch_reason_back_in_line: Mai taimakon ya tafi, don haka hirar ta koma wurinta a layi.
texts.ch_reason_fast_lane: Ya shafi zamba, tsaro ko kariya, don haka ya tafi kai tsaye zuwa waccan ƙungiyar.
texts.ch_reason_handover: An miƙa shi tare da taƙaitawa da duk tarihin.
texts.ch_reason_language: Wannan mutumin yana jin harshen abokin ciniki.
texts.ch_reason_least_busy: Wannan mutumin ne ke da mafi ƙarancin hirarraki a buɗe.
texts.ch_reason_only_one_on_shift: Kai kaɗai ne kake bakin aiki.
texts.ch_reason_out_of_hours: Ya zo bayan lokacin aiki, don haka ya zama ƙara mai lokacin amsa.
texts.ch_reason_rule: Dokar mai kasuwanci don wannan reshe, kaya ko abokin ciniki.
texts.ch_reason_same_helper: Mutum ɗaya ne ya taimaka a karon da ya gabata.
texts.ch_reason_topic: Wannan mutumin yana kula da wannan batu.
texts.ch_side_storefront: Hirar Kantin intanet: mai saye da ya samo tayinka.
texts.ch_sign_away: {first_name} zai dawo nan da kusan mintuna {minutes}.
texts.ch_sign_finding: Muna neman wanda zai taimake ka… Kai ne na {place} a layi.
texts.ch_sign_handover: Muna mayar da kai zuwa ƙungiyar {team}…
texts.ch_stopped: An tsaya. Amsar da aka rubuta zuwa yanzu an ajiye ta.
texts.ch_unread_line: Saƙonnin da ba a karanta ba
texts.ch_warn_never_ask: Wannan yana kama da lambar kati ko lambar sirri. LynkOmni da ma'aikatanta ba sa taɓa neman waɗannan. Za a ɓoye shi kafin a aika.
texts.ch_why_got_chat: Me ya sa na samu wannan hira?
